title: RNA extractions from de-etiolated Arabidopsis seedlings using CTAB
author: Akila Wijerathna Yapa
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3f6gjre

steps.title: Grind Tissues
steps.instruction: Harvest tissues into liquid nitrogen and grind using a mortar and pestle to obtain a fine powder.

substeps.instruction: Keep ground tissue in safe-lock tubes in liquid nitrogen or return to -80°C storage until all samples are processed.

steps.title: Incubate with Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of prewarmed (65°C) extraction buffer to each tube, mix well, and incubate for 5 mins at 65°C (can be extended to 10-15 mins if needed).

steps.title: Perform Chloroform:IAA Extractions
steps.instruction: Perform three rounds of chloroform:IAA (24:1) extraction to isolate the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 ul of chloroform:IAA (24:1) and mix well.
Remove the upper aqueous phase to a new tube, ensuring the interface is not disturbed.
Repeat this process twice more, becoming increasingly conservative when recovering the aqueous phase.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA with LiCl
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 5 M LiCl to the aqueous layer, mix well, and incubate overnight at -20°C.

steps.title: Pellet RNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 14,000 rcf for 20 mins at 4°C.

steps.title: Wash RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet twice with 80% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL 80% ethanol and invert the tube approximately 10 times.
Centrifuge at 7,500 rcf for 5 minutes at room temperature (RT).
Remove ethanol and repeat the wash.

steps.title: Dry and Resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Remove remaining ethanol and resuspend the RNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Remove as much ethanol as possible using a pipette.
Air-dry tubes with the lid open for 1 min.
Resuspend in 30 - 50 ul (depending on expected concentration, e.g., aiming for ~ 500 ng/ul) of DEPC-treated water or low EDTA TE buffer (0.1 mM EDTA, 10 mM Tris base, pH 6.5).

steps.title: Verify RNA Quality
steps.instruction: Check the quality of the extracted RNA.

substeps.instruction: Visualize ~50 ng RNA on a 1% agarose gel or use BioAnalyser / LabChip GXII.
